comparison.objective: Load, uncap, re-cap, and cock a pen lancing device.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential snap removal, small-part insertion, twist-off fracture, snap refit, and sprung-slide actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Lancet seated, tab removed, cap fitted, device cocked and released; unsafe proximity to the exposed needle or dropping the device fails.
comparison.reason: Multi-stage small-device assembly is materially different from size-selective granular separation.
